lex: The designer of Alan B Miller Hall, located in Virginia, was Robert A M Stern. The current tenants are the Mason School of Business, however the Hall’s owner is the College of William and Mary.
The Mason School of Business are the current tenants of Alan B Miller Hall, situated in Virginia, built by Robert A.M. Stern and owned by the College of William and Mary.
